title: Digraphs: two letters that make one sound
examples: Why does ph sound like f?
How many sounds are in ship?

figure.name: x-word
figure.note: Two letters, s and h, make one sound

explain.say: Here is a puzzle for you. The word ship has four letters, but how many sounds? Look at the first box on the board: s and h are stuck together. Together they say shh, like when you ask someone to be quiet.

draw.text: Digraphs: two letters that make one sound

draw.name: x-word
draw.note: Two letters, s and h, make one sound

explain.say: Now the middle box lights up: i, as in in. Then p. So ship has just three sounds: sh, i, p. Two letters making one sound has a special name: a digraph. Can you say ship slowly with me?

draw.name: x-word
draw.note: Two letters, s and h, make one sound

explain.say: Here is another digraph on the board: ch. See the first box? c and h together say ch, like a little sneeze. Blend ch, a, t and you get chat. Can you think of another ch word?

draw.name: x-word
draw.note: c and h say ch together

explain.say: This one is sneaky! In thumb, th starts the word. Now look at the last box: m and b together just say mmm, because the b is silent. So thumb has five letters but only three sounds. Tricky, right?

draw.name: x-word
draw.note: th at the start, a silent b at the end

explain.say: Brilliant work! The board now sorts words by their digraph. Look at the last group: in phone and dolphin, p and h say fff. Challenge: how many sh words can you find in your kitchen? Fish, dish, wash...

faq.a: A digraph is two letters that work together to make one sound, like sh in ship or ch in chip.

faq.q: What are the most common digraphs?
faq.a: The common consonant digraphs are sh, ch, th, wh, ph and ck. Vowels have digraphs too, like ee in tree and oa in boat.

faq.q: Why does ph sound like f?
faq.a: Most ph words came into English from Greek, where that sound was one letter, phi. English kept writing it as ph, so phone and dolphin say f.
asks: Why is phone spelled with ph?

faq.a: A trigraph is three letters making one sound, like igh in night or tch in match. A digraph uses two letters.
Yes. In duck and sock, c and k together make one k sound. It usually comes straight after a short vowel.
asks: Why is duck spelled with ck?

facts: The digraph th makes two sounds: soft in thin and buzzy in this.
ph usually marks a word that came from Greek, such as phone, photo and alphabet.

quiz.show: How many sounds are in the word chop?
quiz.why: ch is a digraph, so chop has three sounds.

wrong.0: c and h join to make one sound, ch.
wrong.1: cho holds two sounds, ch and o.

quiz.say: Which word has the digraph ph?
quiz.show: Which word has the digraph ph?
quiz.why: In elephant, p and h together say f.
